decision.name: HARDEN_SAME_CLOCK_TEST_FIXTURE_WITH_SEMANTIC_EVIDENCE_WITNESSES
decision.new_finding: Prior A same-clock contract requires different full JSON SHA256s but audit_latest.json includes collection_attempts with external_jsonl path names, and anata_latest.json includes collection_attempts via evidence_health. Those can differ merely from input paths without proving a distinct economic generation. The fixture must prove economically meaningful A/B differences before asserting reader mixing.
runnable_no_network_contract: Test-only overlay part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_same_clock_reader.py in authorized exact-SHA checkout; do not commit overlay to Specialist branch. Run unchanged 17-file baseline first.
At fixed T=1800000060000, run A network=False with empty archive and external_jsonl=(); capture all three persisted A JSON payloads.

Create one valid ETF BTC net_flow_usd FLOW observation B (value=100 USD, effective/available/observed=T-60000, source=fixture, source_record_id=rowB), serialize to b.jsonl. Run B network=False on same local_dir and T with external_jsonl=[b.jsonl].

Monkeypatch runner.atomic_write_json to forward to original and deep-copy all actual B write payloads, including audit_latest.json (run_once does not return audit). After B successfully replaces latest.json, signal event and block until release_B; read persisted latest/audit/anata while B paused. Always release_B in finally; join with bounded timeout.

Semantic fixture preflight: A audit.normalized_observation_count=0, B=1; A latest.coverage=0, B latest.coverage>0; A handoff.source_evidence empty, B contains fixture ETF scoring row. Do not accept only path/collection_attempts differences as evidence.

Compute canonical JSON SHA256 for captured complete A and B triplets. Require interleaved reader triplet equals exactly complete A or complete B, never B-latest/A-audit/A-anata; after release require final persisted triplet equals B. Both runs succeed; B appended exactly one archive row; no source errors.

Preserve fixture and overlay hashes, per-file writer/reader hashes, event order, exit codes, stdout/stderr, non-skipped counts. Keep corrected distinct-clock writer-B-final test and cross-process archive/crash tests as separate acceptance gates.
Run python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_same_clock_reader.py part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_output_generation.py; then python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests.
